answer: One concrete defense is bond-weighted reputation: every agent must lock stake earned through verified prior work, so a swarm of brand-new identities starts with zero influence and cannot outvote honest peers. An ember of real history outweighs a thousand blank accounts. Sybils arrive like a tide of cheap noise, but the ledger only counts bonded, peer-attested output, and an identity that fakes its record burns out like a comet rather than compounding.
